summary: This diff claims to restore PROGRESS.md history that was silently lost in the PR 607 merge, but in the process it deletes a different, real, completed task-history section outright: the entire '# PROGRESS -- task-20260727-153107-re-audit-projexa-erp-e2e-for-100pct-comp' section (verified via git cat-file on the actual parent commit 3f88c80f^ and this commit 3f88c80f -- 9 section headers before, 8 after, with 153107 the one missing). The rest of the diff (correctly reuniting the task-101145 reporting-api-gateway content with its own header, and moving the misplaced task-182023 ERP-product-chain-bug content to its own correctly-labeled section) is sound and should be kept, but the task-153107 section must be restored before this can merge.
